note: Per-language starting budgets for the corpus evaluation runner (issue #25). Initial values are sized generously from real local macOS/arm64 release runs (see RESULTS.md), so they trip on order-of-magnitude regressions rather than machine noise. Rust/PHP started from the 2026-08-18 run (~25-100x observed values). TypeScript was added on 2026-08-19 from microsoft/vscode (7.7 s cold, 2.6 GiB peak RSS, 0.53 s warm no-op): ~30x wall, ~3x RSS, ~55x warm no-op. Python was added on 2026-08-20 from django/django and apache/airflow (2.1-5.1 s cold, 0.65-1.6 GiB RSS, 0.13-0.24 s warm no-op): ~50-120x wall, ~5x RSS, ~125x warm no-op. JavaScript was added from react/react (1.9-2.1 s cold, ~520 MiB RSS, ~0.11 s warm no-op): ~30x wall, ~4x RSS, ~90x warm no-op. Java was added from spring-projects/spring-boot and apache/kafka (3.5-5.9 s cold, 0.9-2.0 GiB RSS, ~0.15 s warm no-op): ~40x wall, ~4x RSS, ~190x warm no-op. C# was added from dotnet/runtime (70-87 s cold after indexed extension lookup, 1.6-2.4 GiB RSS, 0.79-0.90 s warm no-op): ~3x wall so the measured 319 s quadratic regression fails, ~3-5x RSS, ~33x warm no-op. Tightening a budget or changing a baseline requires review and a deliberate commit.
